main_text.p: impofita non grave sit tantum, sed aliquid etiam in se contineat quod sit inhumanum, ut si quis ju-beatur se flagellare, dextram sibi praecidere, cicutam bibere, &c. 4.Dico quarto, in ejusmodi casibus tenere[?] quidem reum, ad poenam eam, quam scivit lege constitutam, quamque culpa sua commeruit, pas-sive subeundam ; non item obligari ad activè cooperandum in eadem. Et haec de Legum promulgandarum necessitate, & de Legum Pænalium obligationem[?], quae ad legum causam formalem aliquo modo pertinere videntur, dicta sunto.

page.notes: Left margin "4." is a bare marginal number, placed beside the line "bibere, &c. Dico quarto". Word-level doubts: "tenere[?]" (the final letter is unclear), "activè" (the V in the scan is ambiguous), "obligationem[?]" (the ending is unclear). The word "PRÆ" between the two lower rules is doubtful. It is set apart from the text, may be show-through or a catchword of the neighbouring page, and is left out. The faint lines between and below the rules are show-through and are not transcribed. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
